comparison.objective: Seat a jig plate in its unique orientation on round and diamond locating pins; no detailed body or specs available.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-part orientation, multi-pin alignment, and compliant seating versus narrow-tool coaxial alignment, impact delivery, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Plate fully seated in the only fitting orientation versus four tang fractures with coils retained and fragments contained.
comparison.reason: Both require precision alignment, but pin registration/seating tests a different constraint geometry and outcome. Seating tolerances and damage rules are missing.
